name: LedgerKit verifier semantics
objective: Evaluate whether a model explains safe ledger verification, rejects malformed evidence, and preserves fail-closed behavior.

rubric.description: States that verification checks signatures and integrity before acceptance.
Explains that malformed or unverifiable evidence is rejected by default.
Requires an auditable record of the decision.
Calibrated reviewer assessment of clarity and technical coherence.

controls.oracle: Check the signature and integrity before acceptance. Treat malformed or unverifiable evidence as invalid: reject it and fail closed. Store the decision in an audit log for traceability.
